ios.desc:
Take back control. Quit smoking and vaping the smart way with QuitFlow.
Track your cravings, monitor cigarettes, vaping, and puffs, and build better habits — all in one app. Create a custom quit plan and experience real, sustainable progress every day.

At a glance:
- Track multiple stuff same time (e.g. cigarette, vape etc.)
- Custom quit plan
- Daily gradual limit reduction
- Daily, weekly, and monthly status
- Detailed statistics. Visualize your quit progress over time

Key Features:

▶ Track Smoking, Vaping, and Puffs
Log cigarettes, vape sessions, puffs, nicotine intake, and tar buildup — all from one place.

▶ Custom Quit Plan & Gradual Reduction
Design your personalized quit journey and gradually lower your daily limits, making quitting feel natural and stress-free.

▶ Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Progress Reports
Visualize your quitting progress with beautiful charts and deep insights.

▶ Craving and Trigger Tracker
Record the number and intensity of cravings, along with emotional, location, and activity-based triggers. Identify your peak craving times and outsmart them.

▶ Gaps Tracker & Success Rates
QuitFlow automatically helps you extend the time between cigarettes or vape sessions, reducing consumption effortlessly.

▶ Health Tracker
Monitor improvements in sleep, coughing, digestion, and hydration as your body recovers.

▶ Guided Breathing and Kegel Exercises
Combat cravings and strengthen recovery with science-backed breathing and kegel routines.

▶ Advanced Habit Tracker
Replace smoking with healthier habits. Track habits flexibly — by number, yes/no, timers, and more.

▶ Delay Method Insights
Discover which methods help you delay smoking successfully and reinforce what works best.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Built my first iOS app to quit smoking

quotes.text:
Hey everyone,
I’ve been a smoker for years. Tried dozens of apps, tried quitting cold turkey more times than I can count. Nothing really clicked.

Most apps I found either felt too robotic, too motivational ("Just quit now!"), or they didn’t fit how I needed to change — gradually.
So... I built my own app.
It’s called QuitFlow, and it’s my very first iOS app (yep, 45k lines of code later).

I’m actually a backend developer (Go - primary language) by profession — React Native gave me a way in, and honestly, props to AI code editors too. Without them, this would still be sitting half-finished on my laptop.

But this app is different because it’s built by someone who gets it — not just a dev team guessing what smokers need.

Here’s what QuitFlow focuses on:
- Track both electric (vape) and non-electric (cigarette, weed, etc.) smoking in one app.
- Connect every smoke with a craving — QuitFlow links each smoking session to what triggered it, so you can see deeper patterns over time.
- Understand your habits — quickly spot when, where, and why you smoke the most, and make smarter decisions to avoid those situations.
- Encourages delay, not just quitting — the more you delay your next smoke, the more you stretch the gaps between sessions, the less you smoke overall.
- Built-in habit tracker — quitting gets easier when you replace the habit, not just fight it.
- Simple health tracking — track symptoms like coughing, poop, gastritis, and sleep, and notice real improvements.
